agenda_text:
BELMONT SHORE PARKING AND BUSINESS
  IMPROVEMENT AREA ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 18, 2025
  5365 2ND STREET
  FIRE STATION 8 COMMUNITY ROOM, 9:00 AM

Matthew Peterson, Chair  Jeffrey Cozart, Commissioner
Jann Kronick-Gath, Vice Chair  David Link, Commissioner
Deborah Castro, Commissioner  Jodi Meade, Commissioner

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS OR
  EMAIL COMMENTS TO PW-BSPBIAAC@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENTS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56495  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Belmont Shore Parking and
  Business Improvement Area Advisory Commission meeting of Thursday, August
  21, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56496  Recommendation to receive and file a Long Beach Public Works financial report
  discussing revenues during the period ending August 31, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56497  Recommendation to receive and file the Long Beach Transit Employee Bus Pass
  Program Status for August 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56498  Recommendation to receive and file status updates on Conservation Corps of
  Long Beach’s work in the Belmont Shore area, including responses to requests for
  assistance, for August 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56499  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion regarding the city owned parking
  lots and after-hours parking along the Belmont Shore.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

Opportunity to address the Belmont Shore Parking and Business Improvement Area Advisory

I, Kimberly Luna, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Kimberly Luna at Cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
